label: Help modal open (topbar)
verdict:
**CLEAN** — A well-organized help modal cleanly overlays a clearly labeled 3D design workspace; no overlaps, clipping, or broken-looking UI among the persistent chrome (top bar, left item palette, status bar, zoom/compass controls all render correctly).

Non-blocking micro-observations (not defects):
- "Patio" is partially cut at the bottom of the left palette — normal scroll-cutoff that signals the list scrolls.
- The dimmed top-center hint bar and right-toolbar labels ("SCULPT/BUILD/VIEW") are occluded by the modal, which is expected overlay behavior, not a bug.
